correctness_source: question-ID outcome sets in previously completed isolated scoring reports
disclosure_note: Reference answers are published after all generations and scores completed. Optional original scorer labels fill missing score-event references; existing references must agree. Only the fixed sixty are exported, with no rescoring or generation changes.

reference_answer_provenance.source: data/prepared_v2/validation.labels.jsonl; original isolated scorer input on experiment host; fixed-60 subset extracted once for publication after every generation and scoring completed
reference_answer_provenance.input_scope: Only fixed sixty question IDs are exported; no whole label file is published.
reference_answer_provenance.missing_policy: null only when absent from both supplied original label input and completed score events; never inferred from wrong predictions
